original_test_intent: Prove that a new UFM Fabric Health report detects an approved >100 Gb/s Port RX condition created by two-node IB traffic and emits the expected Fabric Health Report Warning alarm.
original_method: Approve node/link identity and finite IB-Stress profile; capture preexisting alarms; run bounded traffic until the named UFM counter exceeds 100 Gb/s in its confirmed units; timestamp Run New Report; capture report ID/input window; verify one causally matched warning with correct link, threshold, severity and lifecycle; stop traffic and record clear/return behavior.
manual_activity: Fabric owner approves load/path and alarm oracle; operator confirms the UI report/alarm linkage and recovery.
safety_requirements: Do not acknowledge/delete alarms or clear logs without approval
engineer_actions: Approve load envelope and threshold semantics

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic UFM access is insufficient and subnet merger is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved finite IB-Stress, confirm the exact counter crosses 100 Gb/s, then run one named Fabric Health report and correlate its ID/time to the alarm.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB-Stress, Run New Report, Port RX Data Rate >100 Gb/s and named warning retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate synchronized traffic, UFM counter samples, report ID and alarm event in one bounded timeline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds path identity, unit confirmation, alarm baseline/lifecycle and safe load supervision.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic health page PASS does not prove threshold-triggered warning generation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stale alarms or mismatched sampling windows can create a false causal match; excessive load can affect shared fabric.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether decimal/binary Gb/s is shown, aggregation/refresh interval, report content window, expected alarm delay/severity and post-condition clear behavior.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's subnet-merger risk is copied and unrelated; Master and GPT V2 consistently describe an alarm triggered by a health report under load.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by target/load, threshold units, report scope and alarm oracle.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row424 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00006-V002: approve UFM/fabric/node/link identity, finite IB-Stress profile, Port RX units/sampling and >100-Gb/s interpretation, Fabric Health report scope, alarm delay/severity/dedup/clear lifecycle and safe abort limits.

review_improvement: Creates a causal evidence chain from generated traffic through measured threshold and report to the exact alarm.
independent_technical_reasoning: The warning cannot be attributed to this test unless the report window overlaps a verified threshold crossing and preexisting alarms are excluded. Alarm appearance, identity and lifecycle are separate acceptance points from raw bandwidth.
